title: Yosemite Upper Falls high flow, Yosemite CA, 2023-07-13 14:42:17
place: Upper Yosemite Fall, Yosemite Valley, Yosemite National Park, California
audio: natural (camera audio, very quiet: mean -46 dB; mute anyway)
notes: Locked-off tripod shot of Upper Yosemite Fall in high (snowmelt) flow under deep-blue sky; whole 14 s is the same shot, waterfall roaring and mist billowing at the base. Source is 7680x4320 (used the 3840x2160 Commons transcode); I cropped a 16:9 window 2880x1620 at x=173,y=270 (a mild 1.33x zoom) so the waterfall sits at x~0.50 of the output frame, then scaled to 1920x1080. Fall top ~y 0.25, base ~y 0.80. Dark green trees left (x<0.3) and right (x>0.85). Any second is fine; 0-14 all usable. No people, no text, no logos. Only CC BY clip in the set: credit line needed in description. Only the upper fall (1,430 ft) is visible, not the full 2,425 ft three-section system.
fact_en: Yosemite Falls: 2,425 feet / 740 m (NPS Yosemite waterfalls page).
